answer: Tie each paid identity to a hardware attestation. A trusted chip signs one key per device per year, and a bridge contract accepts only keys whose certificate chain checks out. A farm can still buy devices, but each fake name now costs real silicon, so growth follows capital rather than scripts. Hidden links can still run beneath the surface like caves in karst, so reputation should climb this trellis slowly, with pay scaling only after months of steady work from one device.
